item.title: [26.05] hyperscan: 5.4.2 -> 5.4.2.1
item.description:
Fixes #587331 (CVE-2026-28730, CVE-2026-33094, CVE-2026-34017, CVE-2026-40216, CVE-2026-40424, CVE-2026-63540).

hyperscan was removed from master in #579636, so this targets release-26.05 directly.

Upstream changes: https://github.com/intel/hyperscan/compare/v5.4.2...v5.4.2.1

5.4.2.1 adds OpenSSL (HMAC-SHA256 database integrity) and has three build issues that this works around:

  • cmake/build_wrapper.sh locates libcrypto with cc --print-file-name=libcrypto.so, which fails in the sandbox. FAT_RUNTIME then prefixes the OpenSSL symbols (avx2_HMAC, ...) and linking fails. Point it at ${lib.getLib openssl}.
  • unit-hyperscan calls the internal hs_db_free / hs_db_unprotect, which are hidden by -fvisibility=hidden in shared builds. Export them (adds two symbols to libhs.so).
  • tools/hscollider/UltimateTruth.cpp includes util/hash_util.h, which is not in the upstream repo (tag or master). hscollider is an uninstalled test tool built only with withStatic, so skip it.

python3Packages.hyperscan links the static libhs.a and now also needs -lcrypto, otherwise import fails with undefined symbol: CRYPTO_memcmp.

Note: SomOverflow.AllocScratchAcceptsMaxNonOverflowSomCount in unit-hyperscan peaks at ~7 GB RSS. It was OOM-killed locally when the shared and static variants ran their checks concurrently on a 15 GB machine, and passes when built alone.

This PR was prepared with Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5); both commits carry an Assisted-by: trailer. I reviewed the diff and build results.

item.title: apacheHttpd: 2.4.69 -> 2.4.71
item.description:
fixes cve-2026-119618, cve-2026-109163, cve-2026-106023.

Changes with Apache 2.4.71

*) SECURITY: CVE-2026-119618: mod_http2: heap corruption and RCE in assign_headers (cve.mitre.org) Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 in assign_headers() can lead to RCE. This issue affects Apache HTTP Server: from 2.4.55 through 2.4.70. Affected releases of mod_h2 from GitHub: from 2.0.8 through 2.0.42. Credits: Anthropic's OSS Scanner, as vulnerability ANT-2026-MAPKT6MZ

*) SECURITY: CVE-2026-109163: mod_vhost_alias 1 byte stack buffer overwrite (after CVE-2026-63292) (cve.mitre.org) Stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_vhost_alias (afterÂ CVE-2026-63292) This issue affects Apache HTTP Server: 2.4.69 and 2.4.70. Credits: Gustavo Aiello

*) SECURITY: CVE-2026-106023: mod_md NULL pointer dereference leads to child process crash (cve.mitre.org) NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_md during HTTP request processing. This issue affects Apache HTTP Server: from 2.4.30 through 2.4.70. Credits: hexb1n, Yang Song, and JiaSheng He of 360 Vulnerability Research Institute, working with 360 TuLongFeng.

*) mod_md: MDHttpProxy and MDCACertificateFile can now be set per MDomain. New directive MDHttpProxyCACertificateFile sets the CA certificates used to verify an HTTPS proxy. [Michael Kaufmann ]

*) mod_deflate: Read the gzip extra-field (FEXTRA) length as unsigned so a length byte with the high bit set is no longer sign-extended, fixing inflation of gzip streams that carry an extra field. [arshiya tabasum ]

*) mod_remoteip: Apply RemoteIP{Trusted,Internal}ProxyList to the virtual host they are configured in, and merge the proxy entries of the main server and of the virtual host, logging a warning when both have some. PR 70207. [Arturo Bernal]

*) mod_dav: Fix handling of invalid or overflowing "Timeout:" request headers, which could silently grant a lock with an already-expired timeout instead of the RFC 4918 maximum. PR 65788 [Arturo Bernal]

*) mod_http2: Correctly handle the asterisk-form of OPTIONS requests instead of rejecting them as malformed. PR 70195. [Arturo Bernal ]

*) mod_http2: Fix duplicate logging of header limit violations. [Michael Kaufmann ]

*) mod_http2: Fix a crash creating an HTTP/2 session with "H2PushDiarySize 0" and debug logging enabled. [Joe Orton]

*) mod_dav_lock: Fix dav_generic_load_lock_record() reading the indirect-lock key length with the wrong width, which could read back a wrong length on big-endian platforms. PR 70299 [Arturo Bernal]

*) mod_remoteip: Log a connection closed before a complete PROXY protocol header was received at info level rather than as an error. PR 63893. [Joe Orton]
